entries.raw: Our contributions include: (1) SHARP, achieving state-of-the-art 0.957 F1-score through intelligent combination of regex patterns and LLM analysis; (2) rigorous comparison against leading methods under identical conditions; (3) demonstration that hybrid architectures achieve 7-14× speedup over deep learning with superior accuracy; (4) evidence-based deployment recommendations with opensource implementations.
